effect.name: Correction With Power (Switch)
effect.description: Base or blend colors are reduced by the power function.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Correction With Power (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.26 */
parameter.description: Base or blend colors are reduced by the power function.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable manages which color will be reduced. Set to 0 is the blend color will be reduced and set to 1 is the base color will be reduced.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Background Multiplication
parameter.description: This variable defines the background multiplication factor. In previous versions of FSP shaders, it was _Mixing, but this has now been fixed.

parameter.name: Power
parameter.description: This variable determines the exponent to which the sum of base and blend is raised as a function of power.
